I am a veterinarian and Ph.D. student at Seoul National University, working at the intersection of statistics and biomedicine. My current research focuses on single-nucleus RNA sequencing data analysis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

## Research Interests

- Causal inference in biomedical data 
- Single-cell Transcriptomics
- Targeted learning and semiparametric inference 

## Education

- **Ph.D. student**, Veterinary Medicine · Seoul National University · 2024 – present
- **DVM**, Veterinary Medicine · Seoul National University · 2014 – 2021

## Experience

- **Veterinary Officer**, Republic of Korea Air Force · 2021 – 2024

## Coursework

1. **Theory:** Statistical Theory, Probability Theory, Real and Multivariate Analysis
2. **Methods:** Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Data Science, Statistical Machine Learning, Statistical Computing
3. **Applications:** Biostatistics, Genomic and Clinical Data Analysis, Clinical Genomic Medicine, Causal Inference
